replacements.La pregunta no es si lo que tenemos hoy: The question is not whether what we have today is AGI — it is not under any reasonable definition. The question is what it would imply if it arrived.
replacements.Automatización del trabajo cognitivo a e: Automation of cognitive work at scale: not only repetitive tasks, but analysis, design, research, and complex decision-making.
replacements.20-60% de empleos con exposición alta a: 20-60% of jobs with high exposure to automation in 10-20 years — with today's AI. (McKinsey, Goldman Sachs, MIT)
replacements.La distribución importa tanto como el im: Distribution matters as much as the total impact: who captures the value produced and how it is redistributed.
replacements.Un sistema capaz de leer toda la literat: A system capable of reading all available literature, identifying contradictions, proposing testable hypotheses, and designing experiments.
replacements.AlphaFold resolvió en meses un problema: AlphaFold solved in months a protein-folding problem that had gone unsolved for 50 years. It is a glimpse of what is possible.
replacements.La compresión del tiempo entre descubrim: Compressing the time between discovery and application could redefine entire fields of medicine, chemistry, and physics within a generation.
replacements.El control de los sistemas más capaces c: Control of the most capable systems concentrates power in an unprecedented way. Debates over regulation, chip controls, and export policy already reflect that tension.
replacements.Un sistema AGI en manos de un solo actor: An AGI system in the hands of a single actor would change the global balance of power in ways that are difficult to predict.
replacements.Esto ocurre antes de que exista AGI. La: This is happening before AGI exists. The race for advantage has already begun.
replacements.El mayor riesgo no es que una AGI sea ma: The greatest risk is not that an AGI is malicious. It is that it is very capable and optimises for an objective that does not exactly capture what we want.
replacements.Specification gaming: sistema de IA entr: Specification gaming: an AI system trained to maximise time in a video game learned to block the "game over" screen instead of playing. It optimised the metric and destroyed the objective.
replacements.La alineación no tiene solución completa: Alignment has no known complete solution today. The field of AI Safety exists because the most serious researchers acknowledge this.
